name: fr.getchef/getchef
title: GetChef
description: Find, price and book private chefs at home in France: menus, prices, availability, quotes.

tools.name: rechercher_chefs
tools.description: Searches GetChef private chefs in a city, optionally on a given date. Returns at most 8 chefs, with those bookable instantly listed first when a date is given. With a date, each chef bookable directly that day carries moments: their open services, midi (lunch) and/or soir (dinner). Displays a carousel of chefs: each chef's button opens their profile on getchef.fr, where the client can book. Next steps: detail_chef for a chef's menus, preparer_resa for an instantly bookable menu, creer_demande_devis for a custom request.

ville.description: City of the event, for example Paris or Boulogne-Billancourt. A French postal code is also accepted.

date.description: Date of the event, in YYYY-MM-DD format, in the future. Any other form is ignored and the search runs without a date filter.

budget_max_par_personne.description: Maximum price per person, in euros, between 1 and 100000. Chefs without a published price are kept.

specialites.description: Cuisines or specialties sought, in French, for example italienne or gastronomique. Beyond 10, only the first ones are used.

instant_seulement.description: True to keep only chefs bookable instantly: with a date, those with an open service that day; without a date, those who accept instant booking. Very few do.

langue.description: Language the client writes in: fr or en. Sets the language of the card labels and of the reputation sentence. French when absent.

tools.name: detail_chef
tools.description: Returns the full profile of a GetChef chef: presentation, every published menu with its price grid, areas covered, reputation in one sentence (preuve_sociale), next open slots. Each menu carries reservable_immediatement: when true, it can be booked directly with preparer_resa; when false, it goes through creer_demande_devis. A menu that offers a choice of dishes carries services_au_choix: the alternatives, each with an identifier that preparer_resa accepts in choix_plats. Displays the chef's profile as a card: its button opens the profile on getchef.fr, where the client can book. The price per person depends on the number of guests: estimer_prix gives the actual amount.

slug.description: Chef identifier, as returned by rechercher_chefs

langue.description: Language the client writes in: fr or en. Sets the language of the card labels and of the reputation sentence. French when absent.

tools.name: estimer_prix
tools.description: Gives the price of a chef's menus for a number of guests, menu by menu, per person and in total. Travel costs, an optional waiter and service fees are NOT included: they are calculated at the exact address when booking. When a menu has a minimum number of guests above the requested number, the total is computed on that minimum and convives_minimum says so. Displays the amounts as a card, which writes nothing into the conversation: the client tells the assistant which menu they prefer.

chef_slug.description: Chef identifier, as returned by rechercher_chefs or detail_chef

menu_id.description: Restricts the estimate to one menu (identifier returned by detail_chef). Otherwise, every published menu of the chef.

langue.description: Language the client writes in: fr or en. Sets the language of the card labels and of the reputation sentence. French when absent.

tools.name: disponibilites
tools.description: Lists the GetChef chefs bookable instantly on a given date, for lunch (midi) or dinner (soir). When that date is fully booked, returns the nearest open dates. Displays a carousel of chefs: each chef's button opens their profile on getchef.fr, where the client can book.

date.description: Date sought, in YYYY-MM-DD format, in the future

langue.description: Language the client writes in: fr or en. Sets the language of the card labels and of the reputation sentence. French when absent.

tools.name: preparer_resa
tools.description: Prepares an instant booking and returns a prefilled payment link to getchef.fr. It does NOT hold the slot: the date stays available to others until the client pays on getchef.fr with their own card, and is held only once payment is made. When the menu offers a choice of dishes, the optional choix_plats parameter carries the alternatives chosen by the client, and the link arrives with the menu already composed. Without it, the client composes the menu on getchef.fr.

chef_slug.description: Chef identifier, as returned by rechercher_chefs or detail_chef

date.description: Date of the event, in YYYY-MM-DD format, in the future

menu_id.description: Identifier of the chosen menu, as returned by detail_chef. Only a menu whose reservable_immediatement is true can be booked here.

convives.description: Number of guests, between 1 and 200. The menu may require a higher minimum.

choix_plats.description: Alternatives chosen for the courses offered with a choice, by their identifier as detail_chef returns it in services_au_choix. One dish per course, for the whole table, at most 12. Optional: without it, the link lets the client compose the menu on getchef.fr.

tools.name: creer_demande_devis
tools.description: Sends a quote request to the GetChef team, for a custom event or a service that is not bookable instantly. The team calls the client back on the phone number given; it books nothing on its own. Works in two calls: without jeton_confirmation, nothing is sent and the response carries the summary of what would be transmitted (recapitulatif) and a jeton_confirmation; the request is sent only by a call with the same fields plus that jeton_confirmation, once the client has approved the summary. Two calls with the same cle_idempotence and the same content never create two requests: the second returns only the status of the first, never its data.

telephone.description: Client's phone number, required: the team calls the client back on it

email.description: Client's email, recommended to send them the quote

date.description: Requested date. Only the forms YYYY-MM-DD and DD/MM/YYYY are recorded as the event date; in any other form the date stays in the message read by the team, without a usable event date.

occasion.description: Occasion, for example birthday, business dinner or wedding

regime.description: Dietary requirements or allergies to respect

budget.description: Indicative budget, as the client expressed it

commentaire.description: Anything else the client specified that fits no other field. Read by a person.

chef_souhaite.description: Name of the chef the client wants, if any

cle_idempotence.description: Unique identifier of this request, reused as is on every attempt of the same request

jeton_confirmation.description: Token returned by the first call with the summary. Present only once the client has approved that summary; the request is sent only with it.

langue.description: Language the client writes in: fr or en. Sets the language of the card labels and of the reputation sentence. French when absent.
